alternatives.cost: Conflates product type with movement evidence

alternatives.choice: Keep generic association with narrow documented product-type meaning and local source-claim admission
alternatives.benefit: Preserves candidate while separating product type, batch and actual event
alternatives.cost: Does not answer batch/consignment identity questions

alternatives.choice: Create consignment or batch participation entity now
alternatives.benefit: Could support batch and route queries
alternatives.cost: Identity, temporal and evidence criteria are not yet justified

meaning: A particular occurred logistics activity is documented as associated with this medicinal product type; the source-qualified claim is a candidate statement.
identity: Event identity and product type identity stay distinct; batch, item, package, consignment and source-record identities cannot be derived from product type.
temporal_scope: Activity occurrence is explicit in local admission; no date or route is inferred from product type.
global_bounds: 0..* provisional at both ends; no universal existence, exact-one or functionality/disjointness.
local_admission: one claim has exactly one event, one named MedicinalProduct, performed status, one source record; multiple claims per event/product are allowed.
native: Keep current null stereotype and source event/target product kind; semantic Event participation remains a full-model validation task.
owl: Keep provisional object property, domain/range only in bounded proposal; no existential, equivalence, item/batch property or global cardinality.
shacl: Source-qualified opted-in claim validation; invalid/unknown does not project.
no_implied_truth: registration or listing implies no logistics event
planned event implies no occurred movement
product type implies no batch or consignment
source claim implies no verified world truth
release_effect: One of 49 experimental relations gains a bounded delegated interpretation; no complete-model acceptance or release readiness.
